training: No refitting; reuse the 24 frozen experiment-14 heads and their original train/validation/test repository identities
primary: fp32 seed 1729, validation helper-call cap 90 percent
replication: fp32 seed 2718 at the same cap; do not choose a winning seed
heuristic_control: negative normalized baseline top-two score gap = -runtime feature 9; lower gap receives higher helper priority
selection: On validation repository only: enumerate all distinct score thresholds using score >= threshold, plus disabled. Among thresholds with calls <= floor(n*budget/100), minimize total pages; ties prefer fewer helper calls. Never split score ties.
test: Apply selected threshold unchanged to held-out repository; report actual call rate, which may exceed the validation cap under distribution shift
aggregate: Each held-out query appears exactly once for each scorer/budget combination
exploratory_gate: pages <= always-helper, actual calls <= the stated cap, Recall1/10 >= raw baseline; additionally learned policy must have no more pages and no more calls than calibrated gap heuristic at same budget, with at least one strict improvement
cost_scope: Output pages and auxiliary-call count are separate objectives. No CPU-to-token conversion or LLM savings assertion.
independence: Previously observed three-repository docstring proxy; model epoch and threshold share validation data, evaluation labels excluded from both; not an independent final evaluation
